summary: 64-year-old woman died in a bicycle accident during the Icon Eyecare Tour of the Moon ride (~2,800 riders); she lost control descending the east hill; the crash was unwitnessed and speed was not considered a factor; other riders were treated for hypothermia after a thunderstorm squall crossed the park.
notes: Sources cited in the compendium: CBS Denver and the Grand Junction Daily Sentinel.
